events.title: AutoNation Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates on Soft New-Vehicle Sales
events.body: AN Q1 earnings miss as lower new-vehicle sales and rising costs offset strength in parts, service and finance operations.

events.title: Sonic Automotive Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Record EchoPark Results
events.body: SAH tops Q1 EPS estimates as EchoPark profits hit a record. The company also boosts share buyback and dividend payout.

events.title: Lithia Motors Q1 Earnings Call Highlights
events.body: Lithia Motors (NYSE:LAD) reported first-quarter results marked by record revenue and what executives described as continued progress in diversifying earnings across new and used vehicle sales, after-sales, and its captive finance platform.
